newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska fed cattle moderate at $110/dressed -USDA.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska fed cattle moderate at $110/dressed -USDA.

text.p: Nebraska feedlot cattle sold at $110.00 per cwt on a dressed basis in moderate volume, unchanged from Wednesday's active sales, market sources said.
About 10,000 to 15,000 head sold at $110.00/dressed, with a few at $68.00 on a dressed basis, the sources said.
On Wednesday, about 50,000 to 55,000 head sold at $110.00, with some live basis sales at $68.00, they said.
Thursday's sales brought the week-to-date number close to 74,000 head, the sources said. This week's showlist had been estiamted early in the week near 80,000 head.
